name: app-orange-food-delivery-screens-with-badge-and-assistant
title: Orange food delivery app: burger splash, restaurant carousel with assistant chip and map detail
whatItIs: Three phones on beige: an orange onboarding with a cut-out cheeseburger, a scalloped '15% OFF' badge and pill CTA; a home with category chips, tilted restaurant cards and a 'Chips' assistant strip above a black pill nav with an orange active tab; and a pizza detail with rating, time and a route map.
whatItMeans: Appetising and friendly; orange and photography make hunger tangible.
techniques: Cut out the hero food over a patterned orange panel.
Use a scalloped badge for the offer.
Tilt side cards in a carousel.
Add an assistant strip in a tinted pill.

vocabulary.definition: A tinted bar introducing an AI helper.
A map with a path in a bottom sheet.
